correctness.rationale: For u²+v²=w², dividing by gcd(u,v) keeps integer w (valuation argument) and yields coprime legs with support in {p,q}. Primitive opposite parities force 2 in the prime set. If odd leg were 1, a²+1 lies between squares; otherwise odd leg q^b and even 2^a. Factoring (w−2^a)(w+2^a)=q^(2b) with odd coprime factors implies smaller factor 1 and hence (q^b−1)(q^b+1)=2^(a+1). Consecutive powers of two 2 apart are 2 and4, so q^b=3,a=2. Thus only primitive (3,4), all box obstruction edges are scaled by 2^i3^j and move exponent coordinates by (+2,−1). Each line a+2b=t forms a path of length L_t, giving independent size ∑ceil(L_t/2) and all optimizer choices ∏_{even positive L_t}(L_t/2+1). Computing odd L_t counts for R=S=n yields the claimed mod-four quasi-polynomial and density 1/2; other prime supports have no edges and F=RS. Independently enumerated exact Pythagorean pair graphs for all 10 prime supports from {2,3,5,7,11}, rectangle sizes 1≤R,S≤6 (360 comparisons) and brute independence for cells ≤16; every checked graph matched. Universal theorem uses proof, not finite testing.
